[[File:Beastmaster's hound icon.png|left]]
'''Beastmaster's hounds''' are [[Slayer monsters]] requiring level 43 [[Slayer]] to harm. They can be found south of [[Otot]] and near the [[Graveyard (Mazcab)|Goebie Graveyard]] on [[Mazcab]].

==Strategies==
Set up a cannon just south of Otot around the rock. Alternately if at 99 or higher Slayer, collect five souls with [[ushabti]]s and place in the [[Sunken Pyramid]].
